comparisonToPriorConservativeProjection.reason: Apply the same frozen eligibility rule using initial-Draft plus ready transitions and created/merged-within-window bounds, rather than requiring a ready event for every in-window-created merged PR.

scope: 80 positive observations, one unresolved pre-window closed/reopened PR, seven excluded observations and one fixture. Bounds are diagnostic, not authenticated event history. No case/violation adjudication.
